shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git branch --show-current && git status --short --branch && git log -5 --oneline && sed -n '1,420p' ../round-brief.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,180p' src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts
sed -n '80,135p' src/transport/ws/validation.ts
sed -n '450,610p' src/transport/sessionResume.test.ts
sed -n '1,280p' specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md
sed -n '1,280p' specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md
sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml
ls scripts/spec-links 2>/dev/null || true
rg -n \"validated by|specs/hal-engine\" src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts src/transport/sessionResume.test.ts | head -80
rg -n \"spec anchor|spec:\" src test .lore package.json | head -80"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "nl -ba src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '45,190p'
nl -ba src/transport/ws/validation.ts | sed -n '1,135p'
rg -n \"## 3|## 4|user_message|ping|Incoming|Client.*Server|Server.*Client|session_list|list_sessions\" specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md
rg -n \"reanchor|anchor.*fix\" scripts package.json
rg -n \"with resume on but latest off|reads a named id|no id|lookup\" specs/hal-engine-session-resume/spec.md
sed -n '1,120p' package.json"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '95,185p' specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md
sed -n '295,375p' specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md
git diff origin/main...HEAD -- src/transport/sessionResume.test.ts specs/hal-engine-session-resume/spec.md | sed -n '1,260p'
git diff origin/main...HEAD --stat"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short
git diff --check
git diff --stat
git diff -- src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md specs/hal-engine-session-resume/spec.md specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md | sed -n '1,360p'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md specs/hal-engine-session-resume/spec.md specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts && git commit -m "docs(protocol): document conversation list frames" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
